entity.summary: Community-owned open-source self-custodial Web3 wallet lineage originally launched as Tally Ho and renamed Taho in 2023.
entity.notes: First-party history says Tally Ho launched in 2021 and was renamed Taho on 2023-02-21. Current first-party security material says private keys remain on the user's computer.

products.summary: Current Taho self-custodial browser-extension wallet, preserving the earlier Tally Ho wallet lineage.
products.notes: First-party Taho history says Tally Ho launched in 2021; exact initial public release day is not asserted. Current download page lists Chrome and Brave.

events.title: Tally Ho renamed Taho
events.description: The community-owned Web3 wallet formerly known as Tally Ho announced its new Taho name while preserving the existing wallet lineage and project identity.
events.notes: This is a continuity/rebrand event, not a new wallet or browser-extension launch. The first-party announcement states that Tally Ho is now Taho and that the wallet lineage began in 2021.

events.title: Xverse launched Lightning payments through Sati
events.description: Xverse announced on 2026-01-26 that Lightning Network payments had launched in partnership with Sati and were available from the Xverse web wallet, while the user main Bitcoin wallet remained self-custodial.

evidence.title: Meet Taho, the first community-owned Web3 wallet
evidence.notes: First-party rebrand announcement states Tally Ho is now Taho and says the wallet lineage began in 2021.

evidence.title: Taho Security
evidence.notes: Current first-party security page states Taho is 100% self-custodial, private keys stay on the user's computer, and the browser wallet is currently downloadable.

evidence.title: Hello World. Meet Taho
evidence.notes: First-party announcement states that Tally Ho is now Taho and describes the existing wallet lineage as beginning in 2021.

evidence.title: Xverse Gets a Lightning Fast Upgrade in Partnership With Sati
evidence.notes: First-party Xverse announcement explicitly states that Lightning Network payments launched through the Sati partnership.
